platform.name: Creator Foundations
platform.feePurpose: Operational costs that keep World Choir running and the Creator Foundations platform secure and transparent.

foundations.mission: Bringing creative workshops and safe spaces to children recovering from hardship.
foundations.biography: Josh spent a decade documenting community stories before turning his platform into a foundation. After volunteering in shelters and schools, he built Open Hands Studio so creativity could become a daily tool for healing — not a luxury. The foundation funds workshops, art supplies, and mentors who stay with children long after the cameras leave.
foundations.whyStarted: Josh saw how often attention fades after a crisis ends. He wanted a lasting structure that continues to show up for children when the headlines move on.
foundations.howItWorks: Donations fund verified local workshop partners. Every active project publishes progress updates with photos and spending summaries. Josh's team reviews partners quarterly and publishes allocation reports.
foundations.verificationNotes: Identity verified. Legal nonprofit documentation reviewed. Project spending reports audited quarterly.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Most of every gift goes directly to workshop spaces, supplies, mentors, and safe transportation for children. A small share covers coordination. A 5% platform fee helps World Choir keep Creator Foundations secure and working.

projects.title: Lisbon Atelier for Recovery
projects.description: A year-round creative atelier for children rebuilding confidence after family hardship — painting, music, and storytelling with trained mentors.
projects.impactSummary: Already hosting weekly sessions for 64 children.

updates.title: Spring studio opened
updates.description: The atelier welcomed its first cohort with new materials and two full-time mentors.

projects.title: Mobile Creativity Kits
projects.description: Portable art and music kits delivered to shelters so children can create even when space is limited.

foundations.mission: Supporting community kitchens that feed families with dignity and care.
foundations.biography: Amira began cooking for neighbors during a local crisis and never stopped. Bread & Belonging grew from her kitchen table into a network of community meals, grocery support, and quiet companionship for families facing food insecurity.
foundations.whyStarted: She believed hunger is not only about calories — it is about being seen. The foundation exists so families can receive help without shame.
foundations.howItWorks: Funds go to vetted community kitchens and grocery partners. Each project shares meal counts, ingredient sourcing, and volunteer hours.
foundations.verificationNotes: Creator identity verified. Charity registration confirmed. Kitchen partners independently reviewed.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Gifts purchase ingredients, cover kitchen costs, and support volunteers who prepare and deliver meals with care. A 5% platform fee sustains World Choir operations.

projects.title: Winter Tables
projects.description: Warm evening meals and take-home grocery parcels for families through the coldest months.
projects.impactSummary: Over 18,000 winter meals served this season.

updates.title: Midwinter report
updates.description: Partner kitchens expanded evening hours and added culturally familiar meals requested by families.

foundations.mission: Giving children access to books, tutors, and quiet places to learn.
foundations.biography: Elena taught herself English through library books. Today Blue Horizon Literacy builds reading corners, trains volunteer tutors, and sends books into homes where learning materials are scarce.
foundations.whyStarted: She knows how one book can change a child's sense of possibility — and she wanted that chance for many more children.
foundations.howItWorks: Donations fund books, reading spaces, and tutor stipends. Progress is measured by reading sessions completed and books distributed.
foundations.verificationNotes: Verified creator. Registered education nonprofit. Tutor partners reviewed annually.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Support buys books, builds reading corners, and trains tutors. A 5% platform fee helps keep Creator Foundations running.

projects.title: Oaxaca Reading Corners
projects.description: Twelve neighborhood reading corners with bilingual books and after-school tutoring.
projects.impactSummary: Eight of twelve corners already open.

foundations.mission: Restoring clean water access and caring for the land around shared wells.
foundations.biography: Noah grew up walking long distances for water. Quiet Waters funds well repairs, filtration, and community stewardship so families can drink safely and protect the land that sustains them.
foundations.whyStarted: He wanted solutions that last longer than a single donation drive — maintained by the communities themselves.
foundations.howItWorks: Engineers and local stewards co-manage each site. Projects publish before/after documentation and maintenance schedules.
foundations.verificationNotes: Identity verified. Water project partners independently inspected. Maintenance logs reviewed.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Funds repair wells, install filtration, and train local stewards. A 5% platform fee supports World Choir operations.

projects.title: Nakuru Well Restoration
projects.description: Restoring three community wells and training stewards for long-term care.

foundations.mission: Offering gentle mental health support and peer circles for young people.
foundations.biography: Sofia used her voice online to speak honestly about mental health. Northlight Care funds confidential counseling access, peer-led circles, and educational resources that help young people feel less alone.
foundations.whyStarted: She wanted help that feels human — quiet, respectful, and available before a crisis becomes overwhelming.
foundations.howItWorks: Licensed partners provide care. Peer facilitators are trained and supervised. Impact is shared through anonymized wellbeing summaries.
foundations.verificationNotes: Creator verified. Clinical partners licensed. Privacy protocols independently reviewed.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Most gifts fund counseling access and peer circles. A 5% platform fee helps keep the ecosystem trustworthy and online.

projects.title: Stockholm Peer Circles
projects.description: Weekly facilitated peer circles and counseling vouchers for young people.

foundations.mission: Helping displaced families rebuild stability through shelter support and community welcome.
foundations.biography: Kai spent years documenting stories of displacement with care and consent. Harbor of Peace now funds transitional housing support, language help, and welcome circles that treat every family as neighbors — not statistics.
foundations.whyStarted: He wanted generosity to feel personal: a warm room, a patient guide, a community that says you belong here.
foundations.howItWorks: Local welcome partners receive grants. Families consent to how their stories are shared. Projects report housing placements and support hours.
foundations.verificationNotes: Verified creator. Partner NGOs reviewed. Family privacy standards audited.
foundations.howDonationsAreUsed: Support covers transitional housing assistance, language help, and welcome circles. A 5% platform fee sustains Creator Foundations.

projects.title: Osaka Welcome Homes
projects.description: Transitional housing support and welcome circles for newly arrived families.
